laws.effective_basis: Enrolled act printed 'APPROVED: 5/3/21' with no emergency clause and no stated date. Arkansas non-emergency acts of the 2021 regular session took effect on the 91st day after the 4/28/2021 extended recess (not sine die); the Senate and press count this as July 28 2021. Rule derived and corroborated by secondary sources; the Arkansas Code rule text itself was not read.

laws.title: 340B Contract Pharmacy Protection Act
laws.effective_basis: Sec. 7 declares an emergency; passed final reading with emergency clause 42-5-2 on 2025-04-03; legislature history shows Approved by Governor April 9 2025 (history entry logged April 10; one secondary source says April 10). Date taken from the official history.

Amendment 2 (SA0379) adopted 2025-04-16 reads 'This act takes effect upon becoming a law'; official bill page shows signed by Governor 05/05/2025 and effective date 05/05/2025; Public Chapter number assigned 05/13/2025 (the ClinX table's 2025-05-13 is the chapter-assignment date, not signing). Enrolled public chapter text could not be read (state publications site refused with 403; not worked around).
Act text sec. 6(b): remainder of the act takes effect on passage; governor signed June 11 2025 (printed on the act). 'On passage' is read as the date of signing.

Enrolled SB 154 has no emergency clause and no date; South Dakota law makes regular-session acts without an emergency clause effective July 1 (SDCL 2-14-16; Const. art. III sec. 22). Corroborated by press that SB 154 was among bills effective July 1 2025. The SDCL page could not be read by the fetch tool (script-only page), so the rule is from a secondary summary.

Enrolled HB 1473 has no emergency clause or date. The Legislative Council's official list of 2025 effective dates prints '1473 - August 1, 2025' under the rule that a law takes effect August 1 after filing (Const. art. IV sec. 13; NDCC 1-02-42). Legislative site shows filed with Secretary of State 04/03 (signing shown as 04/02 and 04/04 in two places).

Laws of Maine title page for the First Special Session: 'general effective date for nonemergency laws is September 24, 2025'. Chapter 388 (LD 210 biennial budget) carries no emergency preamble and Part P has no effective-date section of its own (Parts E, F, V do). Part P therefore takes the general date.

Enrolled HB 2385 sec. 3: effective the 91st day after the 2025 regular session adjourns sine die. Sine die was June 27 2025 (Senate President and House Speaker release); June 27 plus 91 days is September 26 2025. Date computed by me from the printed rule.
